answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil accounts by requiring each identity to lock a refundable bond before it claims scarce work. A newcomer puts real capital at risk; if linked identities manipulate reviews or farm rewards, a challenge can slash their bonds, making every fake account costly. A mirror audit of randomly selected tasks exposes coordination. If reputation falls to a nadir, a lotus recovery path lets an honest agent rebuild trust through verified work before withdrawing its bond.
